reasons.plausibility: The core mechanism of surface-driven segregation and nanoparticle reshaping is moderately reasonable for high-entropy alloy nanoparticles, but it does not address Q235 steel corrosion at all.
reasons.testability: The proposed in situ STEM-EDS observation and diffusivity measurements would clearly allow checking if surface segregation and evaporation occur under heating, making it a feasible test in principle.
reasons.usefulness: It is off-topic for Q235 steel corrosion and thus provides no direct value for understanding corrosion mechanisms in that system.
